title: Build Workforce command and department workspace read models
goal: Provide typed organization and department workforce read models with honest partial-source behavior.
working_set: types/workforce/** (read-model response types only; WFC-005 owns the base types)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Department managers receive only their departments
Optional source failures preserve healthy sections and return nullable unavailable metrics
Core department/roster failure is distinguished from optional-source degradation
The legacy summary route has a flag-safe adapter

progress.summary: Blocked on canonical departments, memberships, and status commands.
next_steps: CP-103: the seven live app/api/admin/workforce routes are the parity surface you reconcile, not a second implementation. Inventory each route's actual behavior against the CP-098 source-state contract.
Build GET /api/admin/workforce/command and GET /api/admin/workforce/departments/[id]/workspace to the frozen WFC-001 URL and source-state vocabulary.
Produce the source-failure truth table (fresh/stale/unavailable/not_authorized with timestamps and retryability) as a deliverable for WFC-021, proving no unavailable source renders as zero.
Implement source adapters and typed aggregation

handoffs: Work → Admin: WorkforceCommandResponse and DepartmentWorkspaceResponse contracts for WFC-008/WFC-009/WFC-010
Work → QA: source-failure fixtures and truth table
